offers_products.reason: Sells software and digital products: online car marketplace platform, dealer software and website products, Dealer Inspire.

offers_services.reason: Digital advertising and marketing services for dealers and OEMs, plus listing and lead-generation services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Car shoppers use the marketplace and reviews, though dealers pay; consumers choose and receive the listings.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Revenue comes mainly from franchise and independent dealers and automaker advertisers paying for subscriptions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Dealers pay monthly subscriptions for listings, software and marketing products.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dealers and automakers can cut advertising and subscription spending when car sales decline.

big_ticket.reason: Dealers pay modest recurring monthly subscription fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the online marketplace platform, audience traffic and software, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are thousands of local car dealers, many small, plus consumers; automakers are a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Online marketplace and software business needing little physical plant or fleets.

notes: Judgement-based: revenue is mainly dealer subscriptions, so organizations are the paying buyers; consumers are the marketplace users.
